messages.content: Remember that the benchmark should report recall@k, MRR, and latency.
I will keep recall@k, MRR, latency, compression ratio, and retention in the report.
My name is Zhang San and I am a backend engineer.
Nice to meet you Zhang San. I will remember you are a backend engineer.
My project uses Go and PostgreSQL, deployed with Docker Compose on Kubernetes.
Got it. Go, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, Kubernetes. I will note these down.
The API runs on port 8088 with health check at /health endpoint.
Update: the database has been migrated from MySQL to PostgreSQL.
Noted. Database changed from MySQL to PostgreSQL.

The server infrastructure includes three regions: Beijing for primary, Shanghai for secondary, and Guangzhou for disaster recovery. Each region runs multiple Docker containers behind Nginx load balancer.
Three regions: Beijing primary, Shanghai secondary, Guangzhou DR. All behind Nginx with Docker containers.
Monitoring uses Prometheus and Grafana. Alerts go to DingTalk and email.
Prometheus plus Grafana for monitoring. Alerts via DingTalk and email.
My API key is sk-test-12345 and the endpoint is https://api.example.com/v2.
Saved: API key sk-test-12345, endpoint https://api.example.com/v2.
